en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard divided into two photographs. The upper image shows a large conical mountain rising behind a town with a sizeable multi‑storey building or castle complex at the base and smaller village houses in front. The lower image shows a stone building with an attached round tower topped by battlements and a viewing platform; the structure is on rocky ground and resembles an observatory or lookout. Red German text is printed on the card, including a caption for the meteorological station and the place name, with a small red serial number at the bottom.
